import { launch } from './cdp.mjs'

const b = await launch()
const results = []
const check = (name, ok, extra = '') => results.push(`${ok ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL'}  ${name}${extra ? '  -- ' + extra : ''}`)
const has = async (s) => (await b.text()).includes(s)
const data = () => b.eval(`JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('internconnect-data-v1'))`)
const setSelect = (label, value) =>
  b.eval(`(() => { const s = document.querySelector('select[aria-label="${label}"]'); Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLSelectElement.prototype,'value').set.call(s, ${JSON.stringify(value)}); s.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true})) })()`)

try {
  await b.resetData()
  await b.login('a_admin')

  // ---- company requests
  await b.goto('/admin/requests', 1200)
  check('requests page + 3 pending', (await has('Company requests')) && (await has('Naseej')) && (await b.eval(`document.querySelectorAll('tbody tr').length`)) === 3)
  await b.shot('a01-requests')
  await b.click('Naseej', 'tbody button')
  check('request drawer details', (await has('Registration details')) && (await has('Verification checklist')))
  await b.click('View document')
  check('CR document modal', await has('Document preview is not available in the front-end prototype.'))
  await b.eval(`document.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: 'Escape' }))`)
  await b.sleep(300)
  await b.shot('a02-drawer', false)
  await b.click('Approve company')
  let d = await data()
  check('approve -> active + notification + audit', d.accounts.find((a) => a.email === 'admin@naseej.sa')?.status === 'active' && d.notifications.some((n) => n.title === 'Your company was approved') && d.auditLog.some((l) => l.action === 'Company approved'))
  check('approve toast', await has('Company approved.'))
  await b.goto('/admin/requests', 1000)
  await b.eval(`document.querySelector('tbody tr').click()`)
  await b.sleep(300)
  await b.click('Reject request', 'aside button')
  check('reject confirm disabled until reason', await b.eval(`[...document.querySelectorAll('[role=dialog] button')].find(x => x.textContent === 'Reject request').disabled`))
  await b.type('[role=dialog] textarea', 'CR number does not match the registry.')
  await b.shot('a03-reject', false)
  await b.click('Reject request', '[role=dialog] button')
  d = await data()
  check('reject -> rejected with reason', d.accounts.some((a) => a.status === 'rejected' && a.rejectReason === 'CR number does not match the registry.'))

  // ---- users
  await b.goto('/admin/users', 1200)
  check('users page, no admin listed', (await has('Manage student and company access.')) && !(await has('admin@internconnect.sa')))
  await b.type('input[aria-label="Search name or email"]', 'omar@')
  check('search users', (await b.eval(`document.querySelectorAll('tbody tr').length`)) === 1)
  await b.type('input[aria-label="Search name or email"]', '')
  await setSelect('Role', 'company')
  await b.sleep(200)
  check('role filter', !(await has('nora@iau.edu.sa')) && (await has('hr@aramcodigital.sa')))
  await setSelect('Role', '')
  await setSelect('Status', 'suspended')
  await b.sleep(200)
  check('status filter', (await has('Badr Alrashid')) && !(await has('Nora Alqahtani')))
  await setSelect('Status', '')
  await b.sleep(200)
  await b.shot('a04-users')
  await b.click('Aramco Digital', 'tbody button')
  check('user drawer activity', await has('Postings'))
  await b.click('Suspend', 'aside button')
  await b.type('[role=dialog] textarea', 'Posting misleading opportunities.')
  await b.click('Suspend', '[role=dialog] button')
  d = await data()
  const aramco = d.listings.filter((l) => l.companyId === 'c_aramco')
  check('suspend company archives listings', d.accounts.find((a) => a.id === 'c_aramco').status === 'suspended' && aramco.every((l) => l.status === 'removed') && aramco.some((l) => l.suspendedFrom === 'closed'))
  await b.click('Reactivate', 'aside button')
  d = await data()
  const restored = d.listings.filter((l) => l.companyId === 'c_aramco')
  check('reactivate restores listings', d.accounts.find((a) => a.id === 'c_aramco').status === 'active' && restored.some((l) => l.status === 'open') && restored.some((l) => l.status === 'closed') && !restored.some((l) => l.suspendedFrom))
  await b.eval(`document.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: 'Escape' }))`)
  await b.click('Omar Alharbi', 'tbody button')
  await b.click('Suspend', 'aside button')
  await b.type('[role=dialog] textarea', 'Spam applications.')
  await b.click('Suspend', '[role=dialog] button')
  d = await data()
  check('suspend student archives applications', d.applications.filter((a) => a.studentId === 's_omar').every((a) => a.archived === true))
  await b.click('Reactivate', 'aside button')
  d = await data()
  check('reactivate student unarchives', d.applications.filter((a) => a.studentId === 's_omar').every((a) => a.archived === false))

  // ---- postings
  await b.goto('/admin/postings', 1200)
  check('postings page', (await has('Review and moderate all published opportunities.')) && (await has('Software Engineering Co-op')))
  await b.type('input[aria-label="Search posting or company"]', 'stc')
  check('postings search by company', (await has('Data Analytics Intern')) && !(await has('Software Engineering Co-op')))
  await b.type('input[aria-label="Search posting or company"]', '')
  await setSelect('Training type', 'Co-op')
  await b.sleep(200)
  check('training type filter', !(await has('Data Analytics Intern')))
  await setSelect('Training type', '')
  await b.sleep(200)
  await b.shot('a05-postings')
  await b.eval(`[...document.querySelectorAll('tbody tr')].find(tr => tr.innerText.includes('Data Analytics Intern')).querySelectorAll('button')[0].click()`)
  await b.sleep(300)
  await b.type('[role=dialog] textarea', 'Misleading stipend information.')
  await b.click('Remove posting', '[role=dialog] button')
  check('removed posting shows reason', await has('Removed: Misleading stipend information.'))
  d = await data()
  check('company notified of removal', d.notifications.some((n) => n.userId === 'c_stc' && n.title === 'Removed by admin'))
  await b.eval(`[...document.querySelectorAll('tbody tr')].find(tr => tr.innerText.includes('Software Engineering Co-op')).querySelector('a').click()`)
  await b.sleep(800)
  check('View opens the listing', (await b.eval('location.pathname')) === '/listings/l_swe_coop')

  // ---- imports
  await b.goto('/admin/imports', 1200)
  check('imports page badges', (await has('Possible duplicate')) && (await has('Missing info')) && (await has('Ready to review')))
  await b.shot('a06-imports')
  const rowBtn = (title, label) => `[...document.querySelectorAll('div.border-b, div.last\\\\:border-b-0')].find(r => r.innerText.includes(${JSON.stringify(title)}) && r.querySelector('button')).querySelectorAll('button')`
  await b.eval(`[...${rowBtn('Accounting Summer Intern')}].find(x => x.textContent === 'Publish').click()`)
  await b.sleep(300)
  check('publish blocked when info missing', await has('Fill in title, company, city, training type and link before publishing.'))
  await b.eval(`[...${rowBtn('Accounting Summer Intern')}].find(x => x.textContent === 'Edit').click()`)
  await b.sleep(300)
  await b.eval(`(() => { const sels = document.querySelectorAll('#import-edit-form select'); const set = (s, v) => { Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLSelectElement.prototype,'value').set.call(s, v); s.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true})) }; set(sels[0], 'Riyadh'); set(sels[1], 'Internship') })()`)
  await b.click('Save changes', 'button')
  check('edit saved -> Ready to review', await b.eval(`${rowBtn('Accounting Summer Intern')}.length > 0`) && !(await has('Missing info')) === false)
  await b.eval(`[...${rowBtn('Accounting Summer Intern')}].find(x => x.textContent === 'Publish').click()`)
  await b.sleep(300)
  d = await data()
  check('publish creates external listing', d.listings.some((l) => l.title === 'Accounting Summer Intern' && l.source === 'external' && l.status === 'open'))
  await b.eval(`[...${rowBtn('Cloud Support Intern')}].find(x => x.textContent === 'Compare').click()`)
  await b.sleep(300)
  check('compare modal', (await has('Compare similar listings')) && (await has('Already published')))
  await b.shot('a07-compare', false)
  await b.eval(`[...document.querySelectorAll('[role=dialog] button')].filter(x => x.textContent === 'Keep this one')[0].click()`)
  await b.sleep(300)
  d = await data()
  check('keep imported removes old listing', d.listings.find((l) => l.id === 'l_ext_cloud').status === 'removed' && d.listings.find((l) => l.id === 'l_ext_cloud').removedReason === 'Duplicate listing')
  await b.eval(`[...${rowBtn('Senior Software Architect')}].find(x => x.textContent === 'Reject').click()`)
  await b.sleep(300)
  await b.click('Reject', '[role=dialog] button')
  await b.click('Rejected', '[role=tab]')
  check('rejected tab', await has('Senior Software Architect'))
  await b.click('Published', '[role=tab]')
  check('published tab', (await has('Accounting Summer Intern')) && (await has('Cloud Support Intern')))
  await b.goto('/', 1200)
  check('external listing visible publicly', await has('Accounting Summer Intern'))

  // ---- sources
  await b.goto('/admin/sources', 1200)
  check('sources page', (await has('Sync failed')) && (await has("Ma'aden Careers")))
  await b.shot('a08-sources')
  check('sync now disabled for disabled source', await b.eval(`[...document.querySelectorAll('h3')].find(h => h.textContent.includes("Ma'aden")).closest('.rounded-xl').querySelector('button.px-0\\\\!, button[disabled]') !== null`))
  await b.click('Retry')
  check('retry clears error', !(await has('Sync failed')) && (await has('Sync finished. No new listings.')))
  await b.eval(`document.querySelector('button[aria-label="Enable Ma\\'aden Careers"]').click()`)
  await b.sleep(300)
  d = await data()
  check('toggle enables source', d.externalSources.find((s) => s.id === 'src_maaden').status === 'enabled')
  await b.eval(`[...document.querySelectorAll('h3')].find(h => h.textContent.includes('Elm')).closest('.rounded-xl').querySelectorAll('button')[2].click()`)
  await b.sleep(300)
  await b.eval(`(() => { const s = document.querySelector('[role=dialog] select'); Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLSelectElement.prototype,'value').set.call(s, 'Every 6 hours'); s.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true})) })()`)
  await b.click('Save', '[role=dialog] button')
  d = await data()
  check('configure schedule', d.externalSources.find((s) => s.id === 'src_elm').schedule === 'Every 6 hours')
  await b.click('Sync all sources')
  check('sync all toast', await has('Synced 3 sources'))

  // ---- statistics
  await b.goto('/admin/statistics', 2000)
  check('statistics cards + chart', (await has('Student accounts')) && (await has('Applications by status')) && (await b.eval(`!!document.querySelector('.recharts-line')`)))
  await b.shot('a09-stats-30')
  await b.click('7 days', '[role=tab]')
  await b.sleep(500)
  check('7 days range renders', await b.eval(`!!document.querySelector('.recharts-line')`))
  await b.click('All time', '[role=tab]')
  await b.sleep(500)
  check('all time range renders', await b.eval(`document.querySelectorAll('.recharts-line').length === 2`))
  await b.shot('a10-stats-all')
} catch (e) {
  results.push('ERROR ' + e.message)
} finally {
  console.log(results.join('\n'))
  console.log('\nCONSOLE/RUNTIME ERRORS:\n' + (b.errors.filter((x) => !x.includes('favicon.ico')).join('\n') || '(none)'))
  b.close()
}
